title: Demo walkthrough
description: The longer product tour, 60 to 180 seconds: chapter structure and signposting, the one-workflow-end-to-end rule over a feature tour, pacing for a viewer who chose to watch rather than one who has to be hooked, and when to break the material into a series instead of one long cut. Load it for onboarding videos, sales-enablement demos, or any tour too long for launch-playbook's 90-second ceiling.
summary: The longer product tour, 60 to 180s: one workflow done end to end, chaptered, paced for a viewer who opted in.

requires.why: The real, complete workflow footage the tour is built on.
Narration that can orient the viewer ahead of a step.
Checking chapter share of the runtime against the plan.

models.note: Measured, explanatory. This viewer already opted in.

triggers: make an onboarding video for our product
explain our whole product in a video
